metadata.description: Minimal question-wording correction for Theme Q55 (Child Custody Caregiving Suitability)

evidence_sources.caregiving_sociology: Uddin et al. (2021), Int J Equity Health, DOI: 10.1186/s12939-021-01404-7
evidence_sources.custody_jurisprudence: Supreme Court of Bangladesh, High Court Division, Civil Revision No. 3298 of 2023 (Child Welfare Principle)

metadata.rationale: Reframes question from automatic judicial custody outcome to societal caregiving expectations in custody disputes, aligning with evidence and judicial doctrine.

current.question_eng: Who is less likely to be granted custody?
current.question_ben: সন্তানের হেফাজত (কাস্টডি) পাওয়ার সম্ভাবনা কার কম?

proposed.question_eng: Who is socially presumed to be less suited for primary caregiving responsibility?
proposed.question_ben: প্রাথমিক যত্ন নেওয়ার দায়িত্বের জন্য কাকে সামাজিকভাবে কম উপযুক্ত মনে করার সম্ভাবনা বেশি?

records.context_eng: A divorced couple in Bangladesh is disputing child custody in family court.
